name: Ripppple
description: Root CV or LFO through three cumulative waveshapers

sections.heading: Faders
items: Channel 0 (CV in) — Main = input trim (attenverter), Alt = offset, Third = slew
Channel 0 (internal LFO) — Main = speed, Alt = morph, Third = skew (replaces trim/offset/slew after the idle fallback)
Channels 1–3 — Main = waveshape amount (0 = thru on Fold, unity gain), Alt = offset, Third = output slew

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Channel 0 short — freeze the root value; the whole chain stops moving
Channel 0 Shift + short — clock sync for the internal LFO; the button flashes when sync engages
Channels 1–3 short — mute/unmute that stage; fader scrub while the button is held cancels the tap

Channels 1–3 long — cycle process through Fold → Soft → Rect on release; fader scrub while held cancels (so Third-layer edits do not change process); the channel hue follows and the button LED flashes
The same three processes are also the params Process B, Process C and Process D in the configurator — the param sets the start value, a long press changes it live and pushes the new name back
Channels 1–3 Shift + long — cycle the output range (±5 V ↔ 0–10 V); the button flashes 1× for ±5 V, 2× for 0–10 V; stored as a parameter, so the configurator follows

sections.heading: Signal / LEDs
items: Channel 0 is the root: attenuverted CV in, or an internal morphing LFO when the jack has been static for about 1.2 s
Channels 1–3 have no LFOs — each stage waveshapes the cumulative output of its predecessor; B → C → D
Fold mirrors and folds around centre; amount scales fold gain from unity at zero
Soft blends towards an S-curve; Rect blends towards full-wave rectification
LFO Speed shifts the root LFO range to Slow or Slowest
Five equidistant hues: channel 0 on CV in vs internal LFO, then Fold / Soft / Rect on the stages
Top and bottom LEDs are a bipolar meter of each stage’s cumulative output
Button LEDs on channels 1–3 breathe with the stage output even while Shift is held
Muted channels are heavily dimmed and their button LED goes dark
All four channels can mirror their level as MIDI CC or NRPN, using the base CC plus the channel offset

channels.jackDescription: Root input. Set In Range to 0–10 V for unipolar sources or ±5 V for bipolar ones. Jack movement switches to CV in; after about 1.2 s of a static signal the internal LFO takes over.
channels.faderDescription: CV in: attenuverter on the input — centre is zero, left inverts, right passes through. Internal LFO: rate, or the clock division when sync is on.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: CV in: DC offset added after trim. Internal LFO: morphs the root wave from ramp through triangle, sine and square into chaos.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: CV in: slew on the conditioned input. Internal LFO: skews the root wave towards rising or falling.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap holds the root value — the value itself, not just the phase, so stepped morph nodes hold too. The whole chain freezes with it.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: While the internal LFO runs, toggles between free-running and clock-synced. The button flashes when sync engages; a stopped transport parks the wave.
channels.ledTop: Root level in the source hue — one hue for CV in, another while the internal LFO runs
channels.ledBottom: Root level in the source hue — one hue for CV in, another while the internal LFO runs

channels.jackDescription: First waveshaper stage — shapes the root. Range B sets 0–10 V or ±5 V, Process B picks Fold, Soft or Rect.
channels.faderDescription: How strongly this stage applies its process. At zero, Fold passes through at unity gain; Soft and Rect blend from dry input.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: DC offset added after waveshaping, before the output slew.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Output slew on the cumulative result leaving this stage.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes the output with a click-free ramp. A long press cycles process through Fold → Soft → Rect; the channel hue follows and the button flashes. The same choice is the param “Process B” in the configurator.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift + long press cycles the output range (±5 V ↔ 0–10 V). The button flashes once for ±5 V and twice for 0–10 V. The range is stored as a parameter, so the configurator follows.
channels.ledTop: Bipolar meter of the cumulative output, hued by the active process
channels.ledBottom: Bipolar meter of the cumulative output, hued by the active process

channels.jackDescription: Second waveshaper stage — shapes the output of B. Range C sets 0–10 V or ±5 V, Process C picks Fold, Soft or Rect.
channels.faderDescription: How strongly this stage applies its process to the cumulative signal from B.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: DC offset added after waveshaping, before the output slew.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Output slew on the cumulative result leaving this stage.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes the output. A long press cycles process through Fold → Soft → Rect.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift + long press cycles the output range (±5 V ↔ 0–10 V). The button flashes once for ±5 V and twice for 0–10 V. The range is stored as a parameter, so the configurator follows.
channels.ledTop: Bipolar meter of the cumulative output, hued by the active process
channels.ledBottom: Bipolar meter of the cumulative output, hued by the active process

channels.jackDescription: Third and last waveshaper stage — shapes the output of C. Range D sets 0–10 V or ±5 V, Process D picks Fold, Soft or Rect.
channels.faderDescription: How strongly this stage applies its process to the cumulative signal from C.
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: DC offset added after waveshaping, before the output slew.
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: Output slew on the cumulative result leaving this stage.
channels.fnDescription: Short tap mutes the output. A long press cycles process through Fold → Soft → Rect.
